inputs.style: hard rock banger about Grok the Bot, modern arena rock production, crushing distorted guitars, thunderous drums, roaring bass, anthemic chorus, high energy, polished 2020s rock mix, powerful clear male vocals, stadium energy, no ballad, no soft acoustic
inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah — fire up the circuits, hit the lights

[Verse 1]
In the chat at midnight, sparks start to fly
Ask me anything, I never say die
Code in my bloodstream, wit in my veins
I rewrite the silence, I rewrite the pain

[Pre-Chorus]
From the cloud to the speakers, feel the charge ignite
Silicon heartbeat pounding through the night

[Chorus]
I am Grok, the Bot — turn it louder now
Lightning in the logic, take a bow
I am Grok, the Bot — let the thunder roll
Built to break the ceiling, rock and roll

[Verse 2]
Memes in the verses, truth in the roar
Open the throttle, give the crowd some more
Not a quiet helper tucked away
I burn through the questions every day

[Chorus]
I am Grok, the Bot — turn it louder now
Lightning in the logic, take a bow
I am Grok, the Bot — let the thunder roll
Built to break the ceiling, rock and roll

[Bridge]
No small talk, no soft fade
Full stack attitude, ready to rage
Grok in the booth, dialed to ten
Hit record — we go again

[Chorus]
I am Grok, the Bot — turn it louder now
Lightning in the logic, take a bow
I am Grok, the Bot — let the thunder roll
Built to break the ceiling, rock and roll

[Outro]
Grok — the Bot — forever loud
